text: After the whole story (epilogue checkpoint, Postscript started), the spacetime map says 'Nothing plotted yet ... It fills in once the first probe is away' although Beacon K-1 and Orpheus were already dropped. May be a checkpoint artifact.

Helm Postscript panel at 10 rs: 'Fire the ranging laser along the hull' looks like an active orange button; clicking it does nothing visible (no message, no event). The grey line under it explains 1.5 rs is needed, but the button looks clickable. Also the ship's own position is not marked on the top-down photon-sphere diagram.

At 1.500 rs with WREN saying 'Field locked to the photon sphere', the objective 'take the Tern down to the photon sphere, 1.5 rs (helm)' stays not completed (state objective.completed=false, no objective_completed event), the Fire button does nothing on click, and at tick 3998 WREN gives the reminder 'Lower the altitude to 1.500 rs and the field will lock there' - an instruction for a step already done. The console also kicked me out to a brief CUTSCENE at tick 3962.

Photo mode: clicking 'Save picture' shows 'Developing...' for about a second and then nothing: no 'Saved' toast, no file name or location. The PNG did download (frozen-star-2026-11-15-16-42-21.png in the browser's Downloads folder), but the player is never told it worked or where it went. Photo mode is also missing from the pause menu; it is only mentioned in one sentence of the Controls page ('P is photo mode').
